narration: If AI builds your frontend, something still has to handle users, data, uploads, and login behind the screen.
voiceDirection: Clear opening. Emphasize the contrast between frontend and backend.

narration: Supabase gives you several backend responsibilities in one platform: a Postgres database, authentication, storage, functions and APIs, plus realtime updates.
voiceDirection: Steady and visual. Give each backend block a clean beat.

narration: Authentication answers one question first: who is this user? It handles sign up, sign in, sessions, and identity.
The database stores your structured application data: profiles, projects, orders, settings, and the relationships between them.
Storage handles files that do not belong inside a database row, like profile photos, documents, videos, and other uploads.
Functions and APIs let your app run backend logic, call protected services, and coordinate work that should not live only in the browser.
voiceDirection: Emphasize protected services and backend logic.

narration: Realtime lets connected clients react when data changes. Update a record once, and subscribed screens can respond without a manual refresh.
voiceDirection: Slightly more animated to match the data pulse.

narration: Put the pieces together: a user signs up, uploads a profile image, saves a profile record, and the app receives the result. The frontend is what they touch. The backend is what makes the flow real.
voiceDirection: Confident recap. End on 'makes the flow real'.
